name: When is a sale-leaseback a good decision for a homeowner?

mainEntity.name: When is a sale-leaseback a good decision for a homeowner?

acceptedAnswer.text: A sale-leaseback can be a good decision for homeowners who need immediate liquidity from their home equity but require more time to find a new residence, downsize, or address other personal circumstances without the pressure of a hurried move. It's also beneficial for those who want to capitalize on a strong seller's market but aren't ready to relocate. We help clients weigh these benefits against the obligation of becoming a tenant to determine if it aligns with their financial and lifestyle goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: A sale-leaseback is good for homeowners needing immediate cash from their equity but also needing more time to move, or who want to sell in a strong market without immediate relocation pressure.
